request.initial_prompt: Desdemona. Alas, thrice-gentle Cassio, My advocation is not now in tune; My lord is not my lord; nor should I know him Were he in favour as in humour alter'd. So help me every spirit sanctified, As I have spoken for you all my best, And stood within the blank of his displeasure For my free speech! You must awhile be patient. What I can do I will; and more I will Than for myself I dare. Let that suffice you.

raw_segments.text: Desdemona, Alas, thrice-gentle Cassio, My advocation is not now in tune. My lord is not my lord,
Nor should I know him Were he in favour as in humour alter'd.
So help me every spirit sanctified, As I have spoken for you all my best,
And stood within the blank of his displeasure For my free speech.
You must awhile be patient. What I can do I will,
And more I will than for myself I dare. Let that suffice you.
